title: CB: Add fail-closed final-commit release gate
public_pr_body:
CB adds a read-only release-evidence gate tied to actual clean Git HEAD. It refuses missing/failed/empty/older-commit results, altered/missing artifacts, incorrect required migration order or 145/146 markers, unproved backup restore integrity, incomplete mandatory DB suites, post-release browsers, reconciliation and fake-only mock production evidence. Every mandatory proof is pinned in a fixed policy; the manifest cannot silently omit it.

Assumptions: stack on CA #272 so required cutover order is 138/140/141/144/145/146. Only unit/browser skipped cases may carry a per-test exact-head Rhys acceptance with reason/date/review reference; mandatory DB and backup conditions cannot be waived. A complete evidence set is only READY FOR INDEPENDENT REVIEW, never an approval. Hashes establish unchanged artifacts, not truth of an untrusted/manual attestation. CI/operator evidence must be genuine. No current evidence set is asserted as passing.

Validation: 66 gate tests passed, 0 failed/skipped; TypeScript, targeted ESLint and diff check passed. Real DB/browser/backup/mock production evidence remains open. No SQL or data writes by this tool, no merge/deploy/main push, no Ready label. Ownership/handover updates are separate docs-only #271; no docs/ files in this code PR.

- [x] CB: automated fail-closed gate and refusal tests added.
- [ ] Next: genuine complete evidence on the final integrated commit and external reviewer/Rhys decisions.


CI AUDIT FOLLOW-UP REQUIRED: a real old-head run produced 5013 passed assertions but exit 1 because a jsdom UI file could not collect. This #273 head does not yet check actual command exits or unhandled/collection errors. The CI branch adds seven failing-first regressions and the refusal fix, retaining all 66 existing cases. Include that correction in the final integration; do not treat this old head alone as a complete gate. No DB/browser/restore proof is implied.
